text: Really amazing app, it really helps my journey to becoming a better person and probably will help you. Don't get discouraged if didn't do what you know you should for one day, because God is giving you another day and you should use it wisely ( it's already a blessing). Helps you get better and you can't really be lazy. Hope it suits you as it suits for me. God bless P.S. Get back the habit strength and 7-day consistency stats to be in the form of numbers, i like it better that way.
author: Tadija
developer_reply:
Update: Thanks for sharing the update with us, we will work to bring back the old stats as a setting in one of the future updates!
Original: Thank you so much for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that Habit It is helping you on your journey to becoming a better person.

Paul from Habit It
